name: Richard Lovell
story: Timaru District Council’s 2016 Significant Natural Areas report names Richard Lovell among the District Council GIS staff who supported the survey. The report dates the survey to 2005–2016, but does not specify Lovell’s individual start or end dates or the software platform used.

Timaru’s 2016 Significant Natural Areas report names Richard Lovell and Steve Caswell as District Council GIS staff. The report does not establish their individual start dates or identify a software vendor for the 2005 workflow.
